module_role: Full-set qualification and source limitations for use of this compact process-cooling-water skid set as HVAC/BAS takeoff ground truth.
source_limitations: M6.3 is a typed I/O P&ID, not a standalone final points list. It directs the I&C contractor to integrate the PLC system including a points list; the supplied drawing set contains no actual PLC I/O-card, terminal or wiring schedule.
Modbus TCP to Ignition SCADA and mirrored EPICS context are stated, but no register map, address, device topology, IP information, controller model or polling detail is published.

The M6.3 P&ID shows AO TCV MODULATION and AO MAKEUP ACTUATOR. There is no supplied control-valve schedule with valve tag/Cv, actuator model/torque, control-signal range or fail position, so no such attributes are inferred.
M7.0's existing AHU note references adjustment of motorized dampers, but no source damper/actuator schedule or installed damper quantity appears in the supplied set.
M7.0's demand totals separate existing and new PCW demands; a demand table must not be mistaken for a new-equipment quantity schedule or physical point multiplier.

assertions.expected: POINTS LIST, PLC AND IO HARDWARE
